description: Verify that Subscribe to eventgroup 0x02 — DUT Ack + initial event observation
approach:
[Objective]
eventgroup 0x02 Subscribe success: DUT Acks subscription and emits the initial event.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with IPv4 endpoint option.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SubscribeAck/Nack/event per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT response matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked subscribe + emitted notification — normal
